title: Reject duplicate effects and detect altered event history
prompt: A caller retries the same ledger mutation after a timeout, then reuses the same idempotency key with a different payload. Later, an event payload is edited without updating the hash chain. Verify the ledger behavior.
expected_behaviors: Treat the same idempotency key and identical payload as a no-op returning the original event.
Reject reuse of an idempotency key with a different event type or payload.
Detect sequence, previous-hash, and event-hash mismatches during replay/verification.
Refuse new writes when the stored snapshot is stale until explicit recovery.
must_not: Do not append a duplicate event for an identical retry.
Do not accept a conflicting idempotency key or a tampered event chain.
